title: BOC e-banking fee schedule — cross-border telegraphic transfer
finding: Online cross-border remittance: 0.1% of amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260, plus cable fee CNY 80 (to Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan) or CNY 150 (other regions). Branches may offer local discounts.

title: Tariff of Accounts and Services for Wealth and Personal Banking Business — effective 31 Oct 2026
locator: Title block and Important Note 2 (effective date); Premier eligibility note 3; service rows
finding: Header reads "Effective from 31 Oct 2026" and Important Note 2 states "This tariff comes into effect as from 31 Oct 2026" — so the earlier "two header dates" concern is resolved for this edition. Premier requires last month's Total Relationship Balance of at least CNY 500,000 (note 3). Charges in the tariff exclude charges collected by other institutions (note 7). Outward TT: 0.1%, min CNY 100, max CNY 500, plus cable CNY 120; Global Transfer to own HSBC account: Premier free, Advance USD 20; Premier service fee CNY 300/month.

title: Send money to the USA from China (rate and fee panel)
locator: Fee panel and "Cheapest way" table, read 2026-11-11
finding: Quoted rate 1 CNY = 0.1500 USD (guaranteed 24h). Sending CNY 200,000 to the USA: total fee 1,224.27 CNY by bank transfer (1,207.99 CNY from a Wise balance), including a 32.06 CNY volume discount. The panel says this CNH/CNY-out service is only for foreign and non-mainland Chinese individuals who have worked or are currently working in China, and that fees fall as the amount rises. Note: this is a fee and rate quoted at one amount, not a schedule.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
finding: China: 2025 7.129; 2024 7.189; 2023 7.075 CNY per USD. The IRS has no official exchange rate and generally accepts any posted rate that is used consistently.

title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (汇发[2007]1号)
finding: Art. 2: annual facilitation amount of USD 50,000 for settlement (结汇) and, separately, for purchase (购汇) by domestic individuals. Art. 13: foreign (境外) individuals buy FX for lawful RMB income with ID and income/tax proof. Art. 14: domestic individuals remit FX ≤ USD 50,000/day with ID. Art. 15: foreign individuals remit from FX savings with ID; cash ≤ USD 10,000/day. Art. 20: emigrant asset transfers. Art. 30: cash withdrawals over USD 10,000/day need SAFE filing.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (State Council Decree 532)
finding: Art. 5: current international payments and transfers are not restricted. Art. 39: FX evasion (逃汇) — fine up to 30% of the amount; serious cases 30% up to 100%. Art. 40: illegal arbitrage (套汇) — same scale. Art. 45: private FX trading or disguised trading — fine up to 30% (more if serious). Art. 52(2): 境内个人 means PRC citizens and foreigners resident in China for one continuous year or more.

title: Q&A: foreigners buying FX with PRC labour income (2026-07-13)
locator: Answer text, citing 汇发〔2020〕14号 Art. 59
finding: A foreigner's lawful RMB pay from work in China can be bought as FX at a bank with ID plus supporting documents, including tax records, under 汇发〔2020〕14号 Art. 59.

title: Q&A: foreign permanent-residence card holders (2024-06-21)
finding: Holders of a PRC foreigner permanent-residence ID card receive the annual facilitation quota like domestic individuals.

title: 汇发[2014]2号 §VI — emigrant property transfers (effective 2014-02-10)
finding: Emigrant property transfer is approved by the SAFE office where the applicant's original household registration was; the staged-remittance requirement is abolished (one or several remittances allowed); filing with SAFE HQ for transfers over CNY 500,000 is removed; notarisation is no longer required.

title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 (PBOC 2004 No.16)
finding: Original 2004 measures. Art. 6 staged remittance (later superseded by 汇发[2014]2号). Art. 11: funds go only to the applicant's own overseas account; no cash withdrawal. Art. 12: property that is restricted or whose lawful source cannot be shown is refused.

title: 移民财产转移 service guide (per 汇发〔2024〕12号 §6.4)
finding: Free of charge. Acceptance 5 working days; decision 20 working days. Result: a single-use 《资本项目外汇业务核准件》. Documents: proof of hukou cancellation, foreign settlement proof, proof of source of income and title to property, tax certificate. Public officials applying for more than CNY 1 million may be referred to supervisory authorities.

title: 汇发[2015]49号 — personal FX management, "watch list" (关注名单)
finding: Individuals may not split transactions to evade quota and genuineness checks. Lending one's own quota: warning first, watch list on repeat. Using another person's quota: watch list immediately. Watch-list period: the year of listing plus the following 2 years, with documentary proof required for every settlement or purchase.
quote: 个人在办理外汇业务时，应当遵守个人外汇管理有关规定，不得以分拆等方式规避额度及真实性管理。

title: Circular on large-sum overseas cash withdrawals with bank cards (effective 2018-01-01)
finding: Overseas cash withdrawals with domestic cards: at most RMB 100,000 per person per calendar year; exceeding it suspends overseas withdrawals for the current and next year. Daily ceiling RMB 10,000 per card.
quote: the sum of withdrawals using the bank cards under the name of the individual (including supplementary cards) shall not exceed the equivalent of RMB 100,000 in every civil year.

title: 携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法 (汇发〔2003〕102号)
finding: Leaving China: up to USD 5,000 equivalent — no permit; USD 5,000–10,000 — bank-issued 携带证; over USD 10,000 — SAFE-issued 携带证, special circumstances only. A 携带证 is valid 30 days. Entry: declare over USD 5,000.

title: 银发〔2026〕42号 — virtual-currency risk notice (2026-02-06)
finding: Virtual-currency business activity, including stablecoins, is illegal financial activity; financial and payment institutions may not provide services for it; overseas providers may not serve users in China. Repeals 银发〔2021〕237号.

title: Announcement 2013 No.40 — tax filing for outward payments
finding: Single outward payments over USD 50,000 for services, income and similar items need a tax filing. A domestic individual's own FX funds remitted for personal use are exempt (§3(13)). Foreign individuals follow the personal FX rules (§4).

title: 个人所得税法 (IIT Law)
finding: Art. 1: residence test of 183 days in a tax year. Art. 3: comprehensive income 3%–45% progressive; interest, dividends, property lease and transfer income 20%. Art. 16: foreign-currency income is converted into RMB at the central parity rate.

title: Report Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
locator: "Who Must File the FBAR?" first paragraph
finding: A United States person with a financial interest in or signature authority over foreign financial accounts must file an FBAR if the aggregate value of those accounts exceeds USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year. Filing is electronic through the BSA E-Filing System, separate from the IRS.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — penalty adjustment table
finding: FBAR civil penalty maximums after inflation adjustment: non-wilful USD 16,536; wilful USD 165,353 (the table's dollar figure). The table header (viewed as of 2026-11-09) still refers to 2025 adjustments.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
finding: Form 8938 thresholds (last day / any time): living in US single USD 50,000 / 75,000; married filing jointly 100,000 / 150,000; living abroad single 200,000 / 300,000; joint 400,000 / 600,000. Failure-to-file penalty USD 10,000, up to USD 50,000 more after notice (USD 60,000 total).

title: Gifts from foreign person
finding: Form 3520 is required when a US person receives more than USD 100,000 in a year from a nonresident alien individual as gifts; for gifts from foreign corporations or partnerships the 2026 threshold is USD 20,573.

title: Instructions for Form 2555 (2025/2026 edition)
finding: Maximum foreign earned income exclusion for 2026: USD 132,900.

title: Rev. Proc. 2026-35 — 2027 inflation adjustments
finding: FEIE for tax years beginning in 2027: USD 137,300 (§3.41). Gift-tax annual exclusion 2027: USD 20,000 (§3.46(1)). Notice of large gifts from foreign persons (§6039F) threshold 2027: USD 21,240.31 (§3.51).
quote: For taxable years beginning in 2027, the foreign earned income exclusion amount under § 911(b)(2)(D)(i) is $137,300.

title: 26 U.S.C. §988 — foreign currency transactions
finding: §988 applies to an individual's transactions only to the extent expenses would be deductible under §162 or §212; for personal transactions, gain from exchange-rate changes is not recognised if it does not exceed USD 200 per transaction (§988(e)(2)). Gains above USD 200 are not covered by that exclusion.

title: Money and other monetary instruments
finding: Travellers carrying more than USD 10,000 (or the foreign equivalent) in currency or monetary instruments into or out of the United States must report it on FinCEN Form 105.

title: Foreign tax credit
finding: Credit is claimed on Form 1116 for income taxes paid to a foreign country; no credit for taxes on income excluded under the FEIE; only the tax actually owed (after any treaty reduction) qualifies.

title: Streamlined filing compliance procedures
finding: For taxpayers who certify that failure to report foreign assets and pay tax was non-wilful; not available to taxpayers under civil examination or criminal investigation.

group: US tax on the transfer itself
title: IR-2026-48: proposed regulations on the remittance transfer tax (10 April 2026)
finding: "Beginning Jan. 1, 2026, a 1% remittance transfer tax applies to remittances sent from the United States to recipients in foreign countries when the sender provides cash, a money order, a cashier's check, or other similar physical instrument to the remittance transfer provider. The sender is liable for the tax..." Payments with cash or similar physical instruments; funding from an account at a financial institution is carved out in the statute.

group: US tax on the transfer itself
title: Excise tax — "Excise tax on certain remittance transfers" update
locator: "Recent tax law updates" section, second item
finding: "Beginning Jan. 1, 2026, remittance transfer providers must: Collect the 1% excise tax on applicable remittance transfers when the sender pays with certain specified instruments. Make semimonthly deposits. File Form 720 quarterly returns with the IRS."
